verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an API client like Hoppscotch, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. Self-hosting with 'full data ownership' is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented opt-out switch, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
